title: Is Anyone Else Seeing This?

pre.en: Why didn't anyone renew the certificate in time?
pre.zh: 为什么没人及时给证书续期？
options: Arjun forgot to set a reminder.
The reminder went to an email address nobody checks.

intro: 这是团队群里的一段聊天：午饭时间登录服务器挂了，四个人在三个地方一边吃饭一边排查。读的时候留意 remember、forget、stop、try：后面接 doing 还是 to do，意思不一样——「记得做过」和「记得要做」差得可远了。

sentences.zh: 还有谁也遇到这个了吗？
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Login isn't working, and I keep getting the same error on all my test phones.
sentences.zh: 登录用不了，我所有测试机都一直报同一个错。

sentences.en: I've just tried logging in on the website too.
sentences.zh: 我刚在网页上也试着登了一下。

sentences.en: Looks like the login server's gone down.
sentences.zh: 看样子是登录服务器挂了。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: I'm in a café with just my phone.
sentences.zh: 我在咖啡馆，手边只有手机。

sentences.en: I was heading for the door to grab a bite, but dinner can wait.
sentences.zh: 我正要出门随便吃点东西，晚饭等等再说。

sentences.en: In the meantime, could everyone please stop pushing new code?
sentences.zh: 这段时间大家先别推新代码了，好吗？

sentences.en: I tried restarting the server with a sandwich in one hand, but it didn't help.
sentences.zh: 我一手拿着三明治，试着重启了一下服务器，没用。

sentences.en: It'll probably turn out to be something small.
To get to the bottom of it, I need to know one thing.
sentences.zh: 要查清楚，我得先知道一件事。

sentences.en: Did anyone remember to renew the security certificate?
sentences.zh: 有人记得给安全证书续期吗？

sentences.en: I don't remember seeing any email about it.
sentences.zh: 我不记得看到过相关的邮件。

sentences.en: Well, I clearly remember setting a reminder in March.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我清清楚楚记得三月份设过一个提醒。
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: I see your point, but a reminder only works if somebody reads it.
sentences.zh: 你说得有道理，可提醒也得有人看才管用。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: OK, the certificate ran out at midday.
sentences.zh: 好，证书中午十二点到期了。
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: Can someone make sure login works?
sentences.zh: 谁确认一下登录能用了没？

sentences.en: It's 1:25, and all five phones are fine.
sentences.zh: 现在一点二十五，五台手机都没问题。

sentences.en: I turned down cake for this, so it had better not happen again.
sentences.zh: 为了这事我连蛋糕都没吃，所以最好别有下次了。

sentences.en: It went out at 9 a.m. on 3 March, to the old team email address.
sentences.zh: 三月三号早上九点准时发出——发到了团队以前那个邮箱。
就是那个没人看的邮箱？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Next time, let's not forget to change it.
sentences.zh: 下次可别忘了把它改掉。

cards.note: get an error 报错；error message 报错信息。比 mistake 正式，机器出错多用 error。
if a computer system goes down, it stops working
cards.tip: IT 里最常用的说法，主语是系统、服务器、网络；恢复了说 be back up / be back to normal。
cards.example: The website went down for two hours last night.

cards.note: used to say that you have started dealing with a problem or task
cards.tip: 工作群里很常见，说明「我已经在处理了」，别人就不用再动手；不能说 I'm on this problem。
cards.example: "Can someone check the payment page?" "I'm on it."

cards.tip: 进行时 was heading for 是「正往……走」：刚要出门，事情来了。
cards.example: After the meeting, we headed for the pub.

cards.tip: 口语，吃得快、吃得简单；也说 grab a bite to eat。正式场合说 have lunch / have something to eat。
cards.example: Let's grab a bite before the film starts.

cards.note: in the period of time between two events
cards.tip: 常放句首加逗号；也可以放句尾：Let's wait and see in the meantime。
cards.example: The engineer is coming at three. In the meantime, please don't use the lift.

cards.note: 程序员用语：把本地的代码改动传到共享的代码库，来自 git push 这个命令。
to tell someone that you need them to help you
cards.tip: 向谁求助：ask sb for help 或 ask for help from sb；help 前面不加 a。
cards.example: Don't be afraid to ask for help in your first month.

cards.zh: 深吸一口气（给自己壮胆、让自己镇定）
cards.note: to breathe in a lot of air, especially to calm yourself before something difficult
to happen in a way you did not expect, or to be discovered to be true

cards.text: get to the bottom of sth
cards.zh: 查个水落石出；弄清根本原因
cards.note: to find out the real cause of a problem
cards.tip: 说的是查问题、查原因，不用在「读到底」上；后面常跟 it / this / the problem。
cards.example: We need to get to the bottom of these crashes.

cards.note: 网站用来证明「我是我」的电子证书，有有效期，过期了就连不上。平时也指证书、证明：a birth certificate。

cards.zh: 明白某人的意思；觉得某人说得有道理
cards.note: to understand why someone thinks something, and accept that they may be right
set a reminder 设提醒；动词是 remind sb to do sth。
就是 12 p.m.，英式常说 midday，也说 noon。午夜是 midnight。
renew a passport / a contract / a subscription：到期前再续一段时间。
to do or check something so that you are certain it happens
to be the way it usually is again after a problem
cards.tip: normal 前面不加 the；「慢慢恢复」说 get back to normal。
cards.example: The trains are back to normal after the strike.

cards.note: to say no to a request or an offer
cards.tip: 拒绝别人给的东西也能用：turn down a job / an offer / cake。
cards.example: He turned down the job because the commute was too long.
